data.name: Sovereign's Enigma
data.detailed_description:
Explore a vast underground world in a 2D side-scrolling survival adventure. Find survivors, build a team, and battle powerful bosses in the ruins of a forgotten civilization. Uncover the truth behind the Sovereign's Enigma.

The Never-Ending Cycle

Legends speak of a vast cave hidden beneath the surface — a place filled with ancient life and forgotten relics. Many adventurers descend into its depths in search of treasure or answers.

Those who enter soon realize something is wrong. Time passes, civilizations come and go, and yet the cycle continues.

Stranded explorers struggle to survive, forming small communities in the depths. All waiting for the day someone might finally uncover the truth behind the Sovereign's Enigma.

Game Features

Discover a Living Underground Ecosystem

The cave has a unique ecossystem. Creatures hunt, flee, and interact with each other, forming a dynamic world that evolves even when you're not there.

Manage Survivors and Prepare for Expeditions

Find survivors lost in the depths and build your party. Manage their equipment, craft essential tools, and establish camps to prepare for the dangers that await deeper in the cave.

Investigate the Ruins

Uncover fragments of a forgotten civilization through clues, artifacts, and scattered evidence. Piece together the past to understand what happened in this ancient underground world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 7520U with Radeon Graphics
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon(TM) Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
